Presented in living color by artist Vanille_Here, the eigth chapter of Hime Chris' Popuni Girls Panic saga. Now in FULL COLOR! With the Popuni Marina now loyal to him, Kouki seeks to use his new resourse to free his sister from Popuni control. However... what's to say he doesn't get a bit distracted along the way?
